title: Displacement against distance
caption: With v = 6 − 2t the object moves forward until t = 3 s, then back. The signed area under the v–t graph gives the displacement, 5 m; adding the areas as positive gives the distance, 13 m.
alt: Position–time and velocity–time graphs for v = 6 − 2t: the velocity line crosses zero at 3 seconds and the position peaks at 9 metres before falling back to 5.
description: v = 6 − 2t: positive until t = 3 s, negative after.
Area from 0 to 3 s: +9 m. Area from 3 to 5 s: −4 m.
The position graph peaks at 9 m where v = 0, then falls back to 5 m.
